subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier note about funded-account acquisition for {Brand} in Ireland. As challengers like Revolut and N26 push on primary-account share here, the economics get sharper: a neobank reporting a 50 dollar CAC is closer to 85 to 105 dollars per active customer once KYC and onboarding drop-off load in (Prospeo 2026), against consumer banking CAC near 258 dollars on the broader benchmark (First Page Sage 2026). That spread is where reading the funded event back through your MMP rather than the install decides true cost. Worth comparing against your mix?
angle: fresh angle: challenger-bank primary-account push + sourced Irish neobank CAC band 85-258 dollars
